episodes.name: Praeteritus Limbus Vorago
episodes.overviewEn: Hakuno feels a rage build up inside of him as he lives through the repetitive virtual world of SE.RA.PH, and it fills him with a sense of purpose.

episodes.name: Dead Face
episodes.overviewEn: Saber proudly introduces herself and prepares Hakuno for the war ahead. But finding another Master to battle proves to be harder than anticipated.

episodes.name: Golden Wild Hunt
episodes.overviewEn: Hakuno and Saber meet Rin, a self-proclaimed Resistor. Hakuno learns that he must kill Shinji, the Floor Master, in order to ascend to the next level.

episodes.name: No Face May King
episodes.overviewEn: After making it to the next level, Hakuno and Saber are immediately ambushed. Just as things seem hopeless, they meet a stranger named Rani VIII.

episodes.name: Yew Bow
episodes.overviewEn: Rani VIII tells Hakuno about the Floor Master, Dan Blackmore, and they learn why he can never ascend -- no matter how many lives he takes.

episodes.name: The Queen's Glass Game
episodes.overviewEn: After ascending to the mysterious third level, Hakuno meets Alice, a cyber ghost living alone in this haunted wonderland.

episodes.name: Nursery Rhyme
episodes.overviewEn: The only way out of the time loop they're trapped in is to defeat Alice. Hakuno is hesitant, despite knowing how many she's killed before.

episodes.name: Bajiquan
episodes.overviewEn: Rin gets them ready for the fifth level, where a Berserker wanders. There’s no floor master, but something perhaps much worse.

episodes.name: Aestus Domus Aurea
episodes.overviewEn: A familiar-looking girl also named Hakuno Kishinami appears. Later, Saber tells the male Hakuno that she's ready to take on the Berserker once again.

episodes.name: Unlimited/Raise Dead
episodes.overviewEn: Now on the sixth floor, Hakuno and Saber are suddenly attacked by a swarm of beings who look just like Rin and Rani.

episodes.name: Excalibur Galatine
episodes.overviewEn: Hakuno and Saber reach the final floor, where a thousand years ago, a previous incarnation of Hakuno defeated the Master before perishing.

episodes.name: Chakravartin
episodes.overviewEn: Now back on the lowest floor, it seems as if Hakuno and Saber have to start all over again -- and they're running out of time.

episodes.name: Olympia Plaudere
episodes.overviewEn: At long last, the final battle begins. Hakuno’s ultimate opponent reveals his identity and the reasons for constructing this war.
